greeting: Hi! I'm a simple support bot with tips written by our team. What's on your mind today?

crisis.reply: I'm really glad you told me. You deserve support right now. Please call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, 24/7) or reach out to the VIT counselling centre. If you are in immediate danger, call 112.

topics.label: Exam stress
replies: Exams can feel overwhelming. Try splitting revision into 25-minute blocks with 5-minute breaks, and start with one small topic.
It's normal to feel pressure before exams. Write down the three topics that worry you most and tackle the easiest one first.

topics.label: Sleep
replies: Poor sleep makes everything harder. Try putting your phone away 30 minutes before bed and keeping the same wake-up time each day.

topics.label: Loneliness
replies: Feeling lonely in a new place is really common. Joining one club or study group this week can be a small first step.

fallback: I'm not sure I understood. Could you tell me a little more? You can also talk to a counsellor any time.
